tier_rationale: About 1.9 million customer records; system of record for every High-criticality process (BP-01 to BP-05)
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security, Availability, Confidentiality) plus bridge letter
subservice_organizations: Hosting provider and SMS gateway carved out
exceptions_noted: 1 exception: 2 of 40 sampled vendor production changes lacked a documented approval; remediated with a new approval step
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer manages users and roles by least privilege, enables MFA, reviews audit logs and exports, and does not store payment card data or credentials in free-text fields. Mapped to AC-2, AC-3, IA-2(1), AU-6, SI-12. Company gaps: audit log and export review (POAM-003) and credentials in legacy notes (POAM-015)
availability_vs_bia: Stated RTO 8 h and RPO 1 h; BIA needs RTO 4 h for BP-01 and BP-03: **does not meet BIA** (P05 finding 1)
incident_notification_terms: Notify affected customers within 72 hours of confirming an incident; inside the 10-day outer limit for third-party agents (Fla. Stat. 501.171(6)(a))
follow_up: Recovery terms and 24-hour notice at the 2027 renewal; enable restricted-field permissions for legacy notes (vendor bulk redaction tool); obtain carve-out assurance for the SMS gateway

tier_rationale: Identities and authentication for all systems; supports all processes
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 plus status history review
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer configures MFA, conditional access, provisioning, and break-glass accounts. Mapped to IA-2, IA-2(1), AC-2(1), AC-7. No company gaps found in P07
availability_vs_bia: 99.9% availability commitment; BIA needs the identity provider first (1 h); outages in the last year were under 1 hour
incident_notification_terms: Customer notice per the vendor's security incident policy (72 hours)

tier_rationale: Hosts the partner API, mail-in portal, delivery storage, and backups (encrypted with company-managed keys)
assurance_required: Annual review of the provider's SOC 2 Type 2 from its compliance portal
subservice_organizations: None relevant to the services used
exceptions_noted: None relevant to the services used
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer is responsible for identity, network rules, keys, data, and restore testing (shared responsibility, P04). Company gap: restore testing (POAM-007)
availability_vs_bia: Regional services meet the BIA when the company tests failover; the company has not tested (POAM-007)

vendor_and_service: Managed security service provider (MSSP; SYS-11 operator)
tier_rationale: Privileged EDR agents on all endpoints; security logs; detection for every process
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security) plus bridge letter; annual service review with detection tests
exceptions_noted: 1 exception: 1 of 40 high-severity escalations missed the 30-minute target
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer defines log sources and use cases, approves containment, and keeps contacts current. Mapped to SI-4, IR-4, AU-2. Company gap: SYS-01 and application log sources (POAM-003)
availability_vs_bia: Not a recovery provider; the MSSP's continuity plan is tested annually per the report
incident_notification_terms: Call within 30 minutes on high severity (contract)
follow_up: Obtain the SIEM platform provider's SOC 2; add bulk export use cases

vendor_and_service: Payment processor and gateway (SYS-02: P2PE solution and hosted payment fields)
tier_rationale: All card payments; the company's PCI DSS scope depends on its controls
assurance_required: Annual PCI DSS Attestation of Compliance (service provider) and P2PE solution listing; responsibility matrix
report_type_and_period: PCI DSS v4.0.1 service provider AOC dated 2026-05; P2PE solution listed on the PCI SSC website (checked 2026-08-27)
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Merchant must follow the P2PE Instruction Manual (terminal inventory, inspections, training) and must protect the page that embeds the payment fields. Mapped to CM-8, PE-3, AT-2, SI-4. Company gaps: POAM-011, POAM-012, POAM-017
availability_vs_bia: Gateway availability commitment 99.95%; standalone terminal mode covers short outages (P05 BP-03)
incident_notification_terms: Processor notifies merchants per its agreement; the company must notify the acquirer within 24 hours of suspicion (P08)
follow_up: Confirm the responsibility matrix covers the hosted fields version in use
reviewer_and_date: Chief Financial Officer and GRC Analyst, 2026-08-27

vendor_and_service: Contact center platform with call recording and AI summaries (SYS-12, AI-003)
tier_rationale: Call recordings and transcripts with customer data; supports BP-10
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 plus AI addendum (P10)
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer must configure recording announcements and pause recording during payments (Fla. Stat. 934.03; PCI DSS v4.0.1 3.2.1). Company gaps: POAM-022, POAM-015
incident_notification_terms: Base contract: notice "promptly"; AI add-on has no data-use terms
follow_up: Obtain report; sign the data-use addendum for the AI add-on (POAM-009)

tier_rationale: Chat transcripts from about 9,000 chats a month, some with passcodes typed by customers
report_type_and_period: Vendor offers a SOC 2 Type 1 only (2026-02)
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer must not send credentials; must configure retention. Company gaps: input masking and terms (POAM-022, POAM-009)
availability_vs_bia: Not a High-criticality dependency (BP-09 MTD 24 h)
follow_up: Accept the Type 1 for 2026 with the data-use addendum; require Type 2 by 2027-12-31

tier_rationale: Diagnostic logs and photos for about 700 devices a day
report_type_and_period: No SOC 2 report; security questionnaire due 2026-10-31
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer should strip account identifiers before upload. Company gap: POAM-022
availability_vs_bia: Not a High-criticality dependency (technicians diagnose without it)
follow_up: Questionnaire and data-use addendum (POAM-009); decide by 2026-12-31 whether to continue

tier_rationale: Receives about 21,000 drop-off devices a year and retired company media; disposal duty under Fla. Stat. 501.171(8)
assurance_required: Site assessment and certification check annually; serial-level certificates
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Company must sanitize before hand-off (STD-04); recycler must certify by serial number. Company gap: POAM-005
follow_up: Site assessment and contract amendment (POAM-005, POAM-009)

vendor_and_service: Tier 2 example: courier for mail-in shipments
tier_rationale: Devices in transit (data on the device); limited personal data (names and addresses on labels)
assurance_required: Contract terms; security questionnaire every 2 years
report_type_and_period: No SOC 2 report; standard shipping account terms
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Company ships with tracking and signature; customers told to back up and remove accounts where the repair allows
follow_up: Loss-handling and notice terms at the 2027 renewal (P01 R-032)
